t: Lesson 10, safe at work and hired for it.
Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
Let's make sure you use this well and get credit for it.
Use Claude the way you'd work with a trusted outside consultant.
Keep out personal data, passwords and confidential strategy,
unless your company approves it.
And always review before you share.
Check facts, brand and sensitive data.
Here's the rule of thumb.
If you wouldn't email it to an outside consultant,
don't paste it into Claude.
Now climb the ladder.
Chat, projects, skills, scheduled tasks and agents,
each rung makes the next one easier.
Here's how to turn this into a job or a promotion.
Build a portfolio of three real before and after projects.
Share a skill you wrote to show how you think.
Put a number on it like hours saved each week.
And explain how you review the work.
That's the judgment employers want.
Quick recap, stay safe, climb the ladder
and turn what you build into proof.
Your mission, automate one real task,
then write a one paragraph case study with the hours saved.
That's Claude Cowork, you've got the whole system.
Now go put it to work and get credit for it.
